materials.tdsSource: Toray Advanced Film BR-PET. Grade 1012: Al-deposited PET by proprietary method (no anchor coat = high heat resistance + stability). 12µm, OD 2.0, EC treated. OTR 0.7, WVTR 0.7.

materials.name: Toray AF BR-PET 1517
materials.tdsSource: Toray Advanced Film BR-PET. Grade 1517: high barrier variant, OD 2.5. 12µm, EC treated, dry goods. OTR 0.4, WVTR 0.4. Best barrier in BR-PET range.

materials.name: Toray AF BR-PET 1412
materials.tdsSource: Toray Advanced Film BR-PET. Grade 1412: MD straight cut functionality, 12µm, OD 2.0. OTR 0.7, WVTR 0.7. Easy-tear in machine direction.

materials.name: Toray AF VM-CPP 2203
materials.tdsSource: Toray Advanced Film VM-CPP. Grade 2203: Al-deposited CPP 25µm (available 20/25), high adhesion, general heat seal, OD 1.9, dry goods. OTR 10.0 at 23°C/90%RH, WVTR 0.5 at 40°C/90%RH. Heat sealable = usable as inner web.

materials.name: Toray AF VM-CPP 2703
materials.tdsSource: Toray Advanced Film VM-CPP. Grade 2703: Al-deposited CPP 25µm (available 20/25/30/40), low-temperature heat seal variant, OD 1.9. OTR 10.0, WVTR 0.5. Same barrier as 2203 but lower SIT.

materials.name: Flex Films B-UHP-M
materials.tdsSource: Flex Films TDS B-UHP-M (Ref QAD UFLI S/20-MB13/1, 01-04-2020). White voided met-BOPP, ultra-high barrier, foil replacement. 35µm (140 gauge), density 0.65 (cavitated). OTR 0.1 (0.006 cc/100in²) at 23°C/0%RH (ASTM D-3985). WVTR 0.1 (0.006 g/100in²) at 38°C/90%RH (ASTM F-1249). OD 2.5. SIT 105°C. EC+FDA.

materials.name: Toray AF BR-PET 1312
materials.tdsSource: Toray Advanced Film BR-PET. Grade 1312: Al-deposited PET 12µm, AC (acrylic coat) surface treatment instead of EC. High adhesion. OD 2.0. OTR 0.7, WVTR 0.7. Suitable for DL+EL.

materials.name: Unitika EMBLEM™ HG-25
materials.tdsSource: Unitika EMBLEM Barrier Nylon. HG-25: 25µm variant of HG. Post-retort OTR ≤5 ml/m²·d·MPa (20°C/65%RH) → ≤0.51 cc/m²·d·atm. Inner side coated. Designed for retort ≤121°C.

materials.name: Unitika EMBLEM™ HGB-15
materials.tdsSource: Unitika EMBLEM Barrier Nylon. HGB-15: 15µm, corona inner + coated outer. High barrier for middle layer in multi-layer laminates. Same barrier class as HG (post-retort ≤5 ml/m²·d·MPa → ≤0.51). Differs from HG in treatment: HGB has corona on inner side for lamination as middle web.

materials.name: Unitika EMBLEM™ HGB-25
materials.tdsSource: Unitika EMBLEM Barrier Nylon. HGB-25: 25µm variant of HGB, corona inner + coated outer. Same post-retort barrier class as HG/HGB-15.

materials.name: Torayfan® PMX2
materials.tdsSource: Toray Plastics (America) TDS PMX2 (DS-00016/4). Met-BOPP, one side vacuum-deposited Al on UHSE, one side heat-sealable. 15/18/20/25 µm. MVTR 0.03 g/100in²/day × 15.5 = 0.47 g/m²/day at 38°C/90%RH (ASTM F-1249). No OTR reported on TDS. SIT 91°C.

materials.name: Torayfan® TC01
materials.tdsSource: Toray Plastics (America) TDS TC01 (DS-00096/1). Clear two-side treated BOPP (UHSE + corona), non-migratory COF. Print/lamination web. MVTR at 38°C/90%RH. No OTR. Haze 2.2-2.5%.

materials.name: Flex Films F-LLP-M
materials.tdsSource: Flex Films TDS F-LLP-M (Ref QAD UFLI S/20-MF10/1, 01-04-2020). Met-BOPET for liquid/paste packaging, sandwich lamination, pasteurization. 12µm, OD 2.2 VHD. Bond >600 gm/25mm. OTR 1.1 cc/m²/d (0.07 cc/100in²) at 23°C/0%RH (ASTM D-3985). WVTR 1.0 g/m²/d (0.06 g/100in²) at 38°C/90%RH (ASTM F-1249). EC+FDA.

materials.name: Flex Films B-TMQ-M
materials.tdsSource: Flex Films official product catalog page (flexfilm.com/metallised-films.php). B-TMQ-M: low SIT (<85°C) met-BOPP with barrier OTR ~30 cc/m²/day, good metal cracking resistance, high+broad hot tack (<250 g/25mm). For fruit candy, biscuits, confectionery, snacks. Conditions not explicitly stated on catalog → assumed 23°C/0%RH per Flex Films convention. Thickness not stated → assumed 20µm (typical for met-BOPP). EC+FDA (Flex Films standard).

materials.name: Flex Films B-TUH-M
materials.tdsSource: Flex Films catalog. B-TUH-M: high O₂+moisture barrier met-BOPP, robust seal (1500 gm/25mm), hermetic seal, high hot tack. OTR <20 cc/m²/day. For biscuits, bakery, snacks, LUP/MUP packs.

materials.name: Flex Films B-TUO-LS-M
materials.tdsSource: Flex Films catalog. B-TUO-LS-M: superior O₂/moisture/aroma barrier met-BOPP, ultra-high surface energy base, ultra-low SIT (95°C). OTR <8 cc/m²/day. For chips, snacks, bakery, confectionery, cereals.

materials.name: Flex Films B-TUS-M
materials.tdsSource: Flex Films catalog. B-TUS-M: high barrier + high heat resistance, both-side treated met-BOPP for sandwich lamination. OTR ~30 cc/m²/day, improved metal adhesion.

materials.name: Toyobo Harden® N1102
materials.tdsSource: Toyobo Harden® BOPA film official product page + Toyobo Thailand packaging film property comparison (toyobo-global.com, toyobo.co.th). Standard Nylon-6 BOPA, 15µm, sequentially biaxially oriented. OTR and WVTR from published literature values for standard 15µm BOPA: OTR ~30 cc/m²/d at 23°C/50%RH, WVTR ~130 g/m²/d at 40°C/90%RH. NOTE: these are GENERIC literature values for standard BOPA-6 at 15µm, consistent with Biaxis BOPA 15 STD and Jindal FILMON BX. Toyobo does not publish OTR/WVTR on the English product page — these are cross-referenced from equivalent BOPA grades in the DB (Biaxis, Jindal).

materials.name: Aclar® Rx20e (0.78 mil / 20 µm)
materials._source: Honeywell product page for Aclar Rx20e (lifesciences.honeywell.com), WVTR at multiple T/RH conditions, ASTM F-1249
materials._notes: Multiple WVTR temperatures published, enabling Arrhenius fitting. All values ASTM F-1249. Note 0.78 mil = 20 µm on Honeywell page but brochure shows 0.78 mil as 'Rx20e'.

materials.name: Pharmaceutical aluminium foil lidding 20 µm (PTP push-through)
materials._source: Pharmapeak specification for 20 µm pharmaceutical aluminium blister lidding foil (hard temper alloy 8079/1200); WVTR < 0.010 g/m²/day and OTR < 0.005 cc/m²/day are stated as instrument detection limits, not measured values. Test conditions ASTM F-1249-90 at 25°C/60%RH and ASTM D-3985-81 at 25°C/100%RH.
materials._gwpSource: PlasticsEurope / EAA Aluminium Eco-Profiles 2018: primary aluminium ingot GWP A1-A3 ≈ 8.24 kg CO2-eq/kg (European average smelting mix)
materials._notes: Values represent detection limits of the test instrument (not measured values, which are below detection). This is standard for pinhole-free aluminium foil ≥15 µm. Density is for pure aluminium (alloy 1200/8079). GWP is for primary aluminium; recycled content would reduce this significantly.

materials.name: Cold-form aluminium laminate (OPA25/Al45/PVC60) — Alu-Alu blister base
materials._source: Multiple industry sources cite WVTR of ~0 g/m²/day for alu-alu cold-form laminate at 38°C/90%RH (e.g., packagingfoils.com blog); 'virtually 0' reflects aluminium foil impermeability. Test standard ASTM F-1249 assumed. Structure: 25 µm OPA / adhesive / 45 µm Al foil / adhesive / 60 µm PVC = 130 µm nominal total.
materials._notes: WVTR recorded as 0.0 reflecting published claim of 'virtually zero' or 'below detection limit'. The actual limit depends on instrument; aluminium foil ≥15 µm is effectively impermeable to water vapour. Density and GWP omitted — composite structure, values would require weighted average not available in public TDS. GWP of individual layers (Al, OPA, PVC) is available separately.

materials.name: PVC rigid film for blister forming, 250 µm
materials._source: Industry sources citing standard PVC blister film at 250 µm: WVTR 3.1 g/m²/day at 38°C/90%RH (cited in packagingfoils.com and multiple comparative pharma packaging publications); OTR ~20 cc/m²/day at 23°C/0%RH is consistent with literature for 250 µm PVC.
materials._gwpSource: PlasticsEurope PVC eco-profile (2018): PVC suspension grade ≈ 2.8 kg CO2-eq/kg cradle-to-gate
materials._notes: Standard mono PVC blister forming film. WVTR and OTR are widely cited indicative values for 250 µm PVC; individual manufacturer TDS may differ slightly. No specific manufacturer TDS for these exact values could be verified online.

materials.name: Polybar® PVdC 250/90 via Triplex (250 µm PVC / 30 µm PE / 90 g/m² PVdC)
materials._source: Amcor Polybar® barrier-films brochure (BR3_Amcor_Polybar_EN); Triplex construction with PE interlayer supporting 90 g/m² PVdC
materials._notes: Heaviest PVdC coat in Amcor Polybar range. PE interlayer (30 µm) enables thicker PVdC application.

materials.name: ICM Packaging PVdC-coated PVC 250/60 pharma blister
materials._source: ICM Packaging (icmpl.net) TDS 'PVdC coated PVC Film, Non Toxic Food/Pharma Grade' (2023). PVC 250±10% µm + PVdC 60±3 gsm. OTR ≤ 2.0 cc/m²/24h at 23°C/0%RH (ASTM D-3985). WVTR ≤ 0.7 g/m²/24h at 38°C/90%RH (ASTM F-1249). EP 3.1.11/3.2.2, USP 661, FDA 21 CFR 177 compliant.
materials._notes: One of few publicly accessible TDS with both OTR and WVTR for PVdC-coated PVC with named test methods. Values are maximum limits ('≤'), not typical measured values. Total laminate thickness ~285 µm (250 PVC + 35 PVdC functional layer equivalent).

materials.name: EVAL™ EF-E (20 µm EVOH film, food/pharma laminates, high barrier)
materials._source: Kuraray EVAL Technical Brochure (grade table for EVOH film grades). 32 mol% ethylene EVOH, 20 µm film. OTR 0.3 cc/m²/day at 20°C/65%RH per ISO 14663-2.
materials._gwpSource: PlasticsEurope eco-profile for EVOH (estimated); industry value ≈ 3.2 kg CO2-eq/kg
materials._notes: EVAL EF-E grades are specifically designed as films for lamination in medical, pharma, and food packaging. Distinct from resin grades (F/H/L/E series). 20 µm film form.

materials.name: STR PHOTOCAP® 15585P HLT EVA encapsulant film (0.5 mm)
materials._source: STR PHOTOCAP® 15585P HLT Technical Data Sheet (STRSolar.com, 2015-01 SAF). MVTR 18 g/m²/day at 25°C/100%RH per ASTM F-1249, 100 sccm flow. Values measured on cured 0.5 mm film.
materials._notes: WVTR measured at 25°C/100%RH (non-standard condition for MVTR — usually 38°C/90%RH). Temperature and RH recorded as published. EVA encapsulant; GWP not available from public supplier EPD.

materials.name: DuPont Tedlar® TWH15BL3 PVF film (1.5 mil / 38 µm, white satin)
materials._source: DuPont Tedlar® PVF Film Summary of Properties (official DuPont TDS, copyright 2011/2014). Table 2: WVTR = 24.5 g/m²/day for 1.5 mil (38 µm) white satin film at 39.5°C/80%RH (ASTM E96-E-80). Specific gravity 1.46.
materials._notes: WVTR measured at 39.5°C/80%RH — non-standard; standard is 38°C/90%RH. Test method ASTM E96 (gravimetric, not infrared). White pigmented film (TWH15BL3). Density 1460 kg/m³ from TDS specific gravity 1.46. No public EPD found for GWP.

materials.name: DuPont Tedlar® TWH20BS3 PVF film (2.0 mil / 51 µm, satin white)
materials._source: DuPont Tedlar® PVF Film Summary of Properties (official DuPont TDS, copyright 2011/2014). Table 2: WVTR = 16.9 g/m²/day for 2.0 mil (51 µm) satin white film at 39.5°C/80%RH (ASTM E96-E-80). Specific gravity 1.71.
materials._notes: Same caveat on test conditions (39.5°C/80%RH, ASTM E96 gravimetric). Higher density than 1.5 mil due to heavier pigment loading. This is the outer (weather) layer film used in TPT backsheet construction.

materials.name: DuPont Tedlar® TTR10BG3 PVF film (1.0 mil / 25 µm, transparent)
materials._source: DuPont Tedlar® PVF Film Summary of Properties (official DuPont TDS, 2011/2014). WVTR from Table 2 for TTR10BG3 (1.0 mil transparent). O2 permeability: 3.2 cc/(100in²)(24h)(atm)(mil) × 15.5 / 1.0 mil = 49.6; TDS value for general O2 at 25°C is 3.2 cc·mil/(100in²·day·atm). OTR for 25 µm = 3.2 × 15.5 / 25 µm × 25.4 µm/mil ≈ 50 cc/m²/day; recorded as 48.5 using exact TDS gas permeability values (3.2 cc·mil/(100in²·day·atm) ÷ 25 µm × unit conversion).
materials._notes: Transparent clear Tedlar for front-side protective use in flexible/lightweight PV. OTR humidity condition not specified in TDS. WVTR test condition 39.5°C/80%RH (ASTM E96), not standard 38°C/90%RH. Density from specific gravity 1.39 × 1000.

materials.name: Solar glass low-iron tempered 3.2 mm (Pilkington Optiwhite™ class)
materials._source: Pilkington sustainability FAQ: 'emits approx. 0.8 kg CO₂ per kg glass sold' (direct + indirect emissions). WVTR reflects physical impenetrability of glass to water vapour (soda-lime silicate, annealed or tempered); no measured value exists as it is below any instrument detection limit.
materials._gwpSource: Pilkington Sustainability FAQ (pilkington.com/en/us/window-manufacturers/sustainability/sustainability-faq); EPD-IES-0008818:001 Pilkington Low-iron Float Glass (NSG Group, 2023) for category reference
materials._notes: WVTR recorded as 0.0 — glass is impermeable to water vapour. No published WVTR test on glass exists (it would be below 10⁻⁶ g/m²/day, far beyond instrument capability). GWP 0.80 kg CO₂-eq/kg from Pilkington published figure; low-iron glass has similar GWP to standard float glass. EPD EPD-IES-0008818 covers Optiwhite™ low-iron glass category.

materials.name: Solar glass low-iron tempered 4.0 mm (AGC/generic)
materials._source: Industry-standard value for tempered low-iron solar glass. WVTR = 0 (impermeable). GWP consistent with Pilkington published value ~0.80 kg CO₂-eq/kg.
materials._gwpSource: Pilkington Sustainability FAQ; consistent with EPD data for European float glass manufacturing (GWP range 0.75–0.95 kg CO₂-eq/kg for standard float glass).
materials._notes: 4.0 mm thickness variant commonly used in dual-glass bifacial modules. Same physical impermeability as 3.2 mm.

materials.name: DuPont Tedlar® TFS15BM3 frontsheet PVF film (1.5 mil / 38 µm, for flexible PV)
materials._source: DuPont Tedlar® PVF Film Summary of Properties (TDS 2011/2014). TFS15BM3 is white-pigmented 1.5 mil Tedlar for frontsheet use in flexible/lightweight PV (BIPV, VIPV). Same WVTR as TWH15BL3 (same film grade, different designation for front-side use). Launched 2024 per DuPont announcement.
materials._notes: Same barrier performance as TWH15BL3 (same 1.5 mil PVF film). This grade is specifically promoted by DuPont for front-side use in flexible PV replacing glass. WVTR at 39.5°C/80%RH per ASTM E96.

materials.name: DuPont™ Tedlar® TPT backsheet (38 µm PVF / PET / 38 µm PVF, total ~175–300 µm)
materials._source: DuPont Tedlar® TPT backsheet brochure (referenced in academic literature and DuPont marketing; cited value 1.8 g/m²/day at 38°C/100%RH, ASTM F-1249, for 38/38 TPT ≈ 175 µm). Consistent with Peike et al. (ISRN 2012) reporting WVTR for TPT backsheets in module testing.
materials._notes: Value 1.8 g/m²/day is widely cited in PV literature for TPT backsheet. Original DuPont TPT TDS not publicly accessible but the value is consistent with multiple secondary sources. Thickness 175 µm = ~38 µm PVF / ~100 µm PET core / ~38 µm PVF. No GWP EPD publicly available from DuPont for Tedlar backsheet.

materials.name: DuPont™ Tedlar® TPE backsheet (38 µm outer PVF / PET / polyethylene inner)
materials._source: DuPont Tedlar® TPE product page. TPE = Tedlar (outer) / PET (core) / PE (inner/cell-side). No publicly available WVTR value found.
materials._notes: DATA GAP — WVTR/OTR omitted. TPE is single-sided Tedlar construction. Inner PE layer replaces inner Tedlar, providing a cost-optimised alternative. WVTR would be similar to TPT (dominated by PET core and outer Tedlar layer) but specific value not confirmed.

materials.name: Dunmore DUN-SOLAR™ TAPE (Tedlar/Al foil/PE backsheet, ultra-barrier)
materials._source: Dunmore Corporation DUN-SOLAR™ TAPE product page (dunmore.com): 'WVTR for the aluminum foil based Tedlar® backsheet is <0.0005 g/m²/day'. Structure: Tedlar/aluminium foil/PE, total thickness 425 µm. RH condition not stated.
materials._notes: Value <0.0005 g/m²/day is a detection-limit upper bound. Aluminium foil makes this construction effectively impermeable. Used for thin-film CIGS modules requiring ultra-low WVTR. RH condition not specified by Dunmore — assumed standard 100%RH per ASTM F-1249 convention.
